date_from.description: Count members from the UTC day of this time: ISO 8601 or relative like `-7d`. Defaults to `-7d`. The window spans at most 90 days.

date_to.description: Count members up to the UTC day of this time: ISO 8601, relative, or `now`. Defaults to now.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page.

order.description:
`people` (distinct people affected), `observations` (member count), `growth` (members gained over the same-length window before `date_from`), or `recent` (newest member first).

* `people` - people
* `observations` - observations
* `growth` - growth
* `recent` - recent

review_state.description: Only clusters with these reviews (comma-separated): `known`, `resolved`, `not_an_issue`, or `none` for clusters nobody reviewed. Pass `none` to leave out what the team already handled.

scanner_id.description: Only this scanner's clusters. Defaults to every scanner you can read.
